subject: english
stem:
While online maps are easy to update, a paper map still works when a phone has no power.
Which choice gives the central idea?
options: Paper maps retain a useful advantage
Online maps are easy to update
Paper maps are better in every situation

optionRationales.reason: Phones never need power：與 no power 問題相反。
Paper maps retain a useful advantage：while 承認線上優點，主要句強調紙圖在無電時仍可用。
Online maps are easy to update：只抓讓步部分。
Paper maps are better in every situation：原文只指出 no power 情境優勢。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「轉折標記後的修正、限制或作者真正採納的立場」可推出 Paper maps retain a useful advantage；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Paper maps retain a useful advantage 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
